title: CommitTreeAdapter
responsibility: Reads paths and text from one selected Git commit and exposes that commit revision as the source-tree identity.

inputs.name: CommitTreeAdapter.open.root
inputs.description: Repository root passed to GitAdapter. It is not exposed as a public CommitTreeAdapter field.

inputs.name: CommitTreeAdapter.open.reference
inputs.description: Revision expression resolved by GitAdapter.attempt using rev-parse --verify --quiet with the reference suffixed by ^{commit}.

inputs.name: CommitTreeAdapter.read.path
inputs.description: Exact forward-slash path to find in the selected commit tree.

outputs.name: CommitTreeAdapter.open
outputs.description: On success returns an adapter whose readonly revision is the string returned by GitAdapter.attempt for the commit-resolving expression. The caller's root and reference are not retained as public fields.

outputs.name: CommitTreeAdapter.revision
outputs.description: Public readonly source identity for the selected commit. It is the successful GitAdapter.attempt result and is passed to ls-tree; exact hash syntax and output normalization are not specified by the GitAdapter contract.

outputs.name: CommitTreeAdapter.list
outputs.description: Lazily runs recursive, NUL-delimited ls-tree for revision once per adapter instance and caches that Promise. Returned records contain exactly path:string and hash:string. Only output records matching a blob entry with a lowercase hexadecimal object id are included; their order follows Git output. The declared SourceTree and TreeEntry field contracts are empty, so their wider interface shapes are not described.

outputs.name: CommitTreeAdapter.read
outputs.description: Finds an exact path match in list(), then batches its blob hash through cat-file --batch and decodes the reported blob bytes as UTF-8. Requests scheduled in the same immediate tick share one batch; duplicate hashes share one object read and resolve all waiting callers with the same text. Reads are bound to revision and do not access a mutable working tree.

errors.name: Reference does not identify a commit
errors.description: open throws when GitAdapter.attempt returns no value. The message quotes the reference and reads: "<reference> does not name a commit in this repository."

errors.name: Git command failure
errors.description: The adapter.git contract declares Error failures for GitAdapter.attempt, run, and bytes. open propagates attempt failures; list propagates run failures and caches the rejected list Promise for that instance; read propagates list failures.

errors.name: Path absent from selected commit
errors.description: read throws the path followed by ' does not exist at ' and the selected revision when list() has no exact path match.

errors.name: Batch object read failure
errors.type: Error from GitAdapter.bytes; not converted into a read rejection
errors.description: flush awaits bytes but is launched without awaiting or catching it, and read creates only a resolve callback. If bytes rejects, the flush rejection is unhandled and the affected read promises remain unsettled rather than rejecting. No retry, rollback, or recovery is declared.
